text:
sanjay: Heads-up — we got a request from infra to give a contractor SIEM query access (read-only) + a KMS decryption grant for a service account. They included a vague justification. thoughts?

mia: who’s the contractor and what queries do they need to run? read-only to SIEM can still leak PII if not scoped.

sanjay: contractor is from DataOps (vendor: BlueCloud). They claim they need to run incident correlation queries and export short result sets to a ticketing csv. No list of queries yet.

alex: red flags: external vendor + KMS decrypt grant. Why do they need KMS? for exporting encrypted logs? Asking for a service account decrypt seems risky.

elaine: agree. We should require a precise query whitelist and timeboxed access. Also require data minimization & DPA check for vendor.

security-bot: Incident policy reminder — any external access to security logs requires manager approval + 2FA OIDC + ephemeral credentials unless covered by existing contract.

mia: propose: 1) deny permanent KMS grant. 2) offer an audited export pipeline: they submit query definitions, we run in a controlled job that writes sanitized CSV to a pre-approved S3 bucket. 3) If they need direct query access, give a scoped, ephemeral role via Vault with session TTL 8h and query restrictions.

sanjay: that sounds reasonable. We also need an audit trail: every query must log the exact query text and requester and be retained for at least 1 year for compliance. retention policy for those audit logs?

elaine: current retention for SIEM audit logs is 2 years for security events, 6 months for admin queries. Might need to extend admin/query audit to 1 year for vendor access. Check legal.

alex: also check KMS policy: we can grant decrypt-only in a narrow CMK key policy, but better to avoid any key access for external. Use a proxy decryption service inside our VPC that logs requestor and reason.

mia: for GDPR/CCPA: ensure exported datasets are checked for PII. Add automated scrubbing step and manual review for first 3 exports.

sanjay: i'll reply to the ticket with that approach and ask for the exact query set + duration + contract clause. can someone draft the Vault role + example policy?

elaine: i can draft the Vault role and an example SIEM query whitelist template. will attach to the ticket.

alex: i'll work with legal to confirm contract/DPA amendments and retention obligations.

security-bot: Logged access-control discussion to security-requests #5842. Please update ticket with decisions. :white_check_mark:

sanjay: thanks all — i'll hold on approving anything until we get the formal query list and sign-off.

mia: one more: add a scheduled access review in 30 days and set automatic revoke if inactive.

sanjay: done — adding a JIRA subtask for 30-day review.

elaine: I'll drop the vault role draft in the ticket by EOD.
